Construction and reproducibility

Each family dashboard reports requested/observed dates, rows, files, variables, entities, missingness, duplicates, frequency, PIT distribution, descriptive quantiles, source links, input hashes, slice hashes, and explicit limitations.

What the data does not prove

  • No family is labeled complete.
  • Current/revised compilations are not silently treated as historical vintages.
  • Descriptive association is not causation or alpha.
  • Public-source samples can contain selection, survivorship, revision, entity-matching, and timing bias.
  • No broker session, subscription, raw broker artifact, or order system was touched.
  • No audio or video is retained.
